title: ForbiddenOperations
description: Machine-readable avoid-list: the 10 prohibitions every contributor and every agent observes. Migrated from docs/CONSTITUTION.md §Prohibitions — Avoid during the 2026-05-15 CONSTITUTION strike per root-hub-pointers.json _retired_constitutional_authority migration map. Extends the forbidden_primitives concept from master-plan-sequencing.json with a doctrinally-binding avoid set.

_meta.purpose: Canonical avoid-list. Each prohibition binds; violations are structural defects, not stylistic concerns.

prohibitions.title: No parallel canonical trees
prohibitions.statement: Authority lives in docs/. Re-creating a retired authority surface is a regression.

enforcement.evidence: Planned authoritative-tracked lane will verify every authoritative doc is in docs/; current control is PR review plus retired-vocabulary checks.

prohibitions.title: No --no-verify, no hook bypass, no signing skip
prohibitions.statement: Hook failure is a signal; the fix is the underlying issue, not the bypass.

enforcement.evidence: cosign verify-blob pins certificate identity to repo's own workflow file for signing posture; planned pre-push fitness lane will reject commits authored with --no-verify.

prohibitions.title: No force push on main, no destructive history rewrite, no reset --hard on someone else's work
prohibitions.statement: Risky actions require explicit user authorization scoped to the action.

enforcement.evidence: GAP: branch-protection.yaml is currently a YAML spec, not a deployed ruleset (per 2026-05-15 audit). Enforcement effective only after admin applies the ruleset to the GitHub org. Until then, observance is cultural.

prohibitions.title: No untyped values at API boundaries
prohibitions.statement: Use the result types prescribed by the standards.

enforcement.evidence: PR review + docs/standards/error-handling.md compliance; no current programmatic check (gap candidate for governance-api-boundary-typing lane)

prohibitions.title: No new struct fields in kernel crates without data_class annotation

enforcement.evidence: data-class lane scans kernel-crate struct fields for `// data_class:` annotation comment; absence flags PR

prohibitions.title: No quarantining a flaky test without a 14-day fix SLA
prohibitions.statement: Quarantine assigns the test to the flaky/ lane; the SLA is tracked.

enforcement.evidence: no current programmatic SLA tracker for flaky-lane test residence time (gap candidate for governance-flaky-sla lane)

prohibitions.title: No editing legacy retired paths
prohibitions.statement: If a path was retired in a consolidation event, do not recreate it.

enforcement.evidence: ADR-0118 retirement removes the one-time archive lane; M01-P18 admission gates replacement changes per ADR-0116

prohibitions.title: No process-only fix for a recurring incident

enforced_by: docs/MISTAKES-LEDGER.md row contract enforces mechanical_prevention field
enforcement.evidence: MFL-row template rejects rows with empty mechanical_prevention field at authoring time

prohibitions.title: No AGPL / GPL / SSPL / BUSL / RSAL dependencies in product code

enforcement.evidence: license-policy lane scans Cargo.lock + transitive deps against forbidden-license enum

prohibitions.title: No autonomy-tier uplift without policy + runtime gate
prohibitions.statement: Capability bindings declare T1 / T2 / T3 / T4; uplift requires a Cedar policy and a runtime check, not a config flag.

enforcement.evidence: autonomy-ceiling crates validate Cedar policy presence + runtime check on every uplift attempt

severity_levels.critical: Catastrophic outcome possible (data exfiltration, financial loss, irreversible damage). Mechanical enforcement REQUIRED; deferred enforcement is a gap not a posture.
severity_levels.high: Significant doctrinal violation. Mechanical enforcement strongly preferred. Cultural enforcement is a gap.
severity_levels.medium: Quality-of-codebase violation. Cultural enforcement acceptable for now.

enforcement_modes.mechanical: A CI lane / hook / validator refuses non-compliant changes at PR time. Programmatic, deterministic.
enforcement_modes.cultural: No programmatic check today. Compliance via PR review. Gap-tracked candidate for future mechanization.
enforcement_modes.mechanical-deferred: A spec file exists declaring the rule but the runtime enforcement (e.g., GitHub ruleset application, M02-P04 audit-chain) is not yet deployed. Honest distinction from `mechanical`.

references: specs/master-plan-sequencing.json — forbidden_primitives (related but lower-level: tooling vs. doctrine)
